findings.reason: Source-file ID joins are explicitly supported, but independent replicate IDs and individual versus summary status are NOT_FOUND. A5 defines dots and CENS=1 without supplying a censoring threshold or direction. E26, E33 and E34 contain numeric zero with CENS=1; E14 contains a dot with CENS=0. These distinctions must remain intact.
findings.needed_material: Confirm experimental-unit and summary status and obtain the source definition, direction and limit of censoring. Preserve original IDs, dots, numeric zeros and flags without inventing replicates or limits.

findings.reason: A3–A4 establish static nominal PMB exposure in mg/L. Medium, formulation, dose basis and total versus unbound concentration basis are NOT_FOUND. Nominal AMT is not a measured free concentration-time profile.
findings.needed_material: Retain nominal exposure as stated and resolve the concentration basis and relevant experimental conditions before any free-exposure conversion or linkage to animal or human exposure.

findings.reason: DR021, DR022 and DR023 have partial support from the strain-linked MIC, nominal exposure rows and source-authorized ID joins. Free AUC, free peak exposure, a measured free concentration-time profile, binding assessment, exposure-window origin and common comparison window are NOT_FOUND. The fT>MIC duration-versus-percentage convention and percentage denominator are also NOT_FOUND. No exposure or threshold-crossing calculation was performed.
findings.needed_material: For each index, document its definition, units, free-exposure input or planned upstream output, binding assessment when needed, window and time origin, and common response-record mapping. Define the fT>MIC duration or percentage convention.

findings.reason: The item provides BAA1705 log10 CFU/mL observations, TIME values, static nominal exposures, a broth-microdilution MIC, TIME=0 responses and a control series. The supplied control response times are 0, 1 and 2 h; treated observation windows vary. Time origin, a defined baseline/comparator endpoint, medium, susceptibility standard, MIC replicates and summary definition, and independent response replicates are NOT_FOUND. Static concentration groups do not establish varied dosing frequency or interval.
findings.needed_material: Clarify time origin, endpoint and comparator definitions, control coverage for the intended endpoint, medium and susceptibility measurement context, replicate structure and static-exposure conditions. Assess design discrimination downstream without inventing dose-fractionation records.

findings.reason: DR026, DR027 and DR028 are not matched as defined targets. The item supplies candidate response inputs but does not state stasis, 1-log kill or 2-log kill effect definitions, their reference points, common endpoint windows, index-specific target values or uncertainty.
findings.needed_material: Define each effect, reference baseline or comparator and endpoint window separately. Link eligible matched exposure-response inputs to the later T05 estimation task; retain target estimates as deferred outputs rather than missing measurements.
